content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Domestic manufacturers are sounding the alarm as free trade agreements continue to erode local industries, leading to job losses and economic instability.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: A recent study by the Economic Research Institute indicates that imports from countries with which the U.S. has free trade agreements have surged, putting pressure on American producers.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Proponents of free trade argue that these agreements create jobs and stimulate growth, but critics contend that they come at too high a cost to domestic industries.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Congressional hearings are scheduled to discuss potential revisions to existing trade deals, with stakeholders on both sides eager to shape the outcome.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Trade experts predict that any changes will be closely watched by global markets, with implications for international relations and economic policy.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: "It's time to protect American jobs and industries before it's too late." - Rep. Sarah Johnson, Trade Committee Member
